describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a pale background with small tufts of grass under its feet. It has the overall body shape, dense shaggy fur, head and paws of a brown bear, with dark brown fur on the back, head and limbs and paler cream-tan fur on the muzzle, chest and belly. A single long, glossy, dark reddish-black curved horn projects upward and forward from the center of its forehead, and multiple large, shiny, dark reddish-brown chitinous plates resembling beetle elytra are set into the fur on the neck, back, sides, hips and outer leg joints. A row of six small oval black openings is visible in the light fur on the lower side beneath the largest lateral plate.

Thick shaggy brown fur covers the body with paler cream fur on the lower side and chest. A single long glossy black curved horn with small barbs rises from the center of the forehead. Multiple glossy dark reddish-brown segmented beetle-like shell plates are set into the fur on the back, upper side, rump, shoulders, neck and upper legs, with a row of six small black oval spots on the pale side fur below the large mid-side plate.
